hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: A mass shooting in Krakow's central square that left six people dead and over a dozen wounded has sent shockwaves through Poland. Authorities opened a terrorism probe into the 25-year-old gunman, citing strong links to ultra-nationalist ideology, while PiS leadership called for the cancellation of political protests out of respect for national mourning.
hotspots.affect: The tragic loss of life combined with explicit far-right extremist motives has triggered widespread alarm, intense political debate over radicalization, and a solemn national consensus around mourning.

hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: In the wake of severe Republican midterm losses, the MAGA ecosystem is reeling from internal recriminations and leadership threats. House Democrats are actively pushing resolutions to impeach Secretary of War Pete Hegseth over the Iran conflict, while GOP figures publicly criticize Stephen Miller's elevation and raise doubts about JD Vance's 2028 prospects.
hotspots.affect: High affective charge stems from existential panic within the MAGA movement, aggressive impeachment threats from opposition leaders, and bitter intra-party finger-pointing over the defeat.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats Drop Cabinet Demand
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson reshaped the Swedish political landscape by announcing the party will drop its requirement for cabinet posts in a future right-wing government, opting instead to act as a cross-bench kingmaker. The strategic shift led to high-profile resignations, including MP Linus Bylund, and sparked intense debate over coalition dynamics.
hotspots.affect: The sudden strategic shift creates emotional turbulence among grassroots supporters while setting off intense speculation about the stability and direction of Sweden's right-wing bloc.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his presidential election defeat, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's sudden departure to the United States has ignited intense public backlash, with polling showing 62% of Brazilians reprove his flight. Concurrently, the Electoral Supreme Court (TSE) opened multiple new investigations into election conduct as allies debate seeking a pardon for Jair Bolsonaro.
hotspots.affect: Public anger over Flávio's abrupt travel joins ongoing ideological friction over electoral integrity and legal accountability, driving intense focus across Brazilian news outlets.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen and Rassemblement National are intensifying their early 2027 presidential campaign rhetoric, clashing sharply with Left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon over social and economic policy. The party simultaneously faces heightened hostility on the ground, marked by disruptive vandalism against Jordan Bardella's book tour and media scrutiny over historical party links.
hotspots.affect: Disproportionate focus is driven by high-stakes presidential rivalry, sharp emotional debates over minimum wage policy and national identity, and targeted street protests against party figures.
